title.rendered: Laser Caps Vs. Hair Transplant Surgery? Which Should You Try First?

content.rendered:
LASER CAPS ARE 5X CHEAPER THAN HAIR TRANSPLANTS AND HAVE A 93% CLINICAL SUCCESS RATE! 

Did you know some hair transplants fail? Did you know most hair transplant patients are prescribed our laser caps for post-op so their results will improve and last longer? Did you know there are other natural treatments for hair loss on the market today? Kiierr laser caps are a less invasive, natural, easy treatment for hair loss and for a fraction of the price. 

How Does a Hair Transplant Work?

Hair transplants involve surgery that moves hair you already have to fill an area of your scalp with thin or no hair. Are you thinking what I’m thinking, OUCH!?

The surgeon will clean your scalp and inject numbing medicine to the back of your head to remove hair follicles from a more dense area of your hair (referred to as the donor area). These hair follicles are then transplanted into small incision areas on the affected areas of your scalp. There are two main types of hair transplants:

  • Follicular Unit Strip Surgery (FUSS) – The surgeon removes pieces of skin from the donor areas. Then using a microscope, splits up the donor skin into tiny follicle pieces containing one or several hair follicles and then inserts these pieces into the needed areas of your scalp.
  • Follicular Unit Extraction (FUE) – The surgeon uses a tiny one-millimeter in diameter (or less) tool, to remove individual follicle pieces from your scalp. This tool makes small circular incisions around the follicle areas to detach the graft. The device makes a tiny circular incision around the follicular unit to isolate the graft. The graft is then removed from the scalp and prepped for transplant placement.

How Does the Kiierr Laser Cap Work?

Avoid going under-the-knife using a Kiierr laser cap, a natural/sustainable treatment option! Kiierr’s laser caps systems are hands free, completely automated, easy to use, and concealed in a standard ball cap design, providing the most consistent scalp coverage on the market today. The system is one of the most powerful and comprehensive hair growth systems developed. It is proven to restore hair growth in just thirty minutes every other day.

These caps are designed using low-level laser therapy to stimulate the blood flow in your scalp and decrease inflammation. By increasing blood flow in your scalp, the proper nutrients and oxygen levels can be transported to the scalp to help regrow stronger, thicker, and healthier hair follicles.

Kiierr offers three different laser caps, 148 laser diodes (650nm wavelength) and the others holding 272 (650nm wavelength). The more lasers diodes a laser cap has, the more effective it will be. Kiierr uses nothing but the best quality medical grade laser diodes in their caps for maximum growth results. Kiierr laser caps have a built-in automatic timer to track your treatment time during therapy. This makes your treatment an amazingly easy, convenient, and stress less process.

LLLT Caps Can Be More Effective – Some Hair Transplants Fail

Hair transplant procedures aren’t a one and done thing since, in some cases hair loss tends to continue even after a hair transplant. Especially in patients who are genetically sensitive to DHT.

We often have hair transplant patients that buy one of our Kiierr laser caps to increase their odds of a hair transplant working. We even offer additional hair growth products and supplements to help you reach your maximum hair growth goals!

Surgery Comes with Health Risks and Is More Invasive

Hair transplants are not only invasive, but costly with major health risks. Some of which include infection, pain, permanent scarring, numbness of sensation on the treated areas, swelling, etc. Some hair grafts even fail to grow evenly after a transplant.

There’s a lot that can go wrong during the process of a hair transplant, leading to dead hair follicles:

  • Poor Technique – Some of the hair follicles from the donor area undergo stress through the process and end up splitting.
  • Overharvesting –  Harvesting too many hair follicles from the donor area to the point of no return. 
  • Drying Out – If the hair follicles are left outside of your body for too long they can completely dry out.

All of these issues can lead to poor hair growth and deficient hair follicles. Leaving your scalp looking patchy, poor, and uneven. Not to mention terrible scarring in some cases!

Laser Caps are More Affordable Than a Hair Transplant

The price of a hair transplant generally depends on how large the amount of hair you’re moving, but usually ranges between $4,000-$15,000, and unfortunately insurance doesn’t cover this cost.

Kiierr laser cap prices range from $695-$1,295, depending on how many laser diodes and whether you purchase the complete system. Kiierr even offers you a full refund if you’re not satisfied with your purchase after 7-months of use. In addition, Kiierr offers a 2-year product warranty, so you can feel confident with your purchase.

See What Customers are Saying About Kiierr

“What I discovered was that low level laser light therapy was not only safe/FDA cleared but was likely the only REAL way to regrow my hair without surgery. So, I took a leap, used this laser cap every other day for a few months and am happy to share that I again have the thick, beautiful hair of my high school days!” -Mike A.

“In our society, hair loss is recognized as the unwanted but unavoidable companion to those approaching their “golden years” – NOT their late 30’s. For the average person, early-onset hair loss is extremely upsetting; but as an independent hair care professional… it’s devastating. After years of experimenting with several products (which almost always left me with a long price tag & short term results.) I decided to invest in the Kiierr Laser Cap: 272 Premier Model; not only is the battery life incredible (providing multiple treatments with ONE charge) but after only SIX months of continuous use there has been a remarkable improvement in the strength, structure, and integrity of my existing hair with noticeable growth in those previous ‘problem areas.” – Mark G.

Read more customer reviews here. 

Conclusion 

We’re real hair experts, here to tell you that there are other options than surgery. Kiierr laser hair caps are the future of hair recovery, providing you with an alternative way to healthy, strong, growing hair. 

Kiierr laser caps are a natural and sustainable treatment option for hair loss. For a fraction of the cost, no risks or adverse effect to your health, and being able to do it in the comfort of your own home, what’s there to lose? With a money back guarantee, why not try Kiierr before surgery??? If it doesn’t work, you can send it back for a full refund after seven months of use. Avoid surgery and buy a laser cap!
